task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. Your first objective is to attempt to go to the west. If you can finish that, travel south. Then, make an attempt to go east. Following that, make an effort to go east. Next, try to go north. Once you accomplish that, move east. And then, pick up the Microsoft limited edition keycard from the floor of the kitchen. After that, venture west. And then, go south. And then, make an attempt to go east. With that accomplished, unlock the Microsoft limited edition gateway. After that, ensure that the Microsoft limited edition gateway is open. After that, head south. That done, make an effort to go to the west. After that, make an attempt to take a trip south. That done, go east. Next, go to the south. And then, make an attempt to go west. With that done, try to travel west. Then, recover the cookie from the floor of the cookery. And once you've done that, you win!
